description: Row identifier (train: record_id)
derivation: copied; first id kept for merged duplicates

description: One of 12 canonical zones
derivation: clean_zone() label map

description: Start of the hour, Addis local time
derivation: parse_mixed(); +03:00 dropped

description: Trips requested in the zone-hour (train only)
derivation: negatives -> missing and dropped; x8 corrupted counts (trips/active_drivers > 2.5) divided by 8; duplicate zone-hours averaged

description: Hour of day 0-23
derivation: ts.hour

description: Day of week, Monday=0
derivation: ts.dayofweek

description: Saturday or Sunday
derivation: dow >= 5

description: 0-167 position in the week
derivation: dow*24+hour

description: Day of month
derivation: ts.day

description: Month 1-12
derivation: ts.month

description: Last days / first days of the month
derivation: day >= 25 or day <= 3

description: Public holiday date
derivation: date within a public_holiday event

description: Day before a public holiday
derivation: next day is a holiday

description: Date inside a school break
derivation: date within a school_break event

description: Air temperature, deg C (July F values converted)
derivation: join on EAT hour (weather +3 h)

description: Rain in the previous hour, mm (-9999 -> 0)
derivation: join on EAT hour

description: Relative humidity %
derivation: join on EAT hour

description: Wind speed km/h
derivation: join on EAT hour

description: Rain over the last 3 hours, mm
derivation: rolling sum of rain_mm (3 h)

description: Rain over the last 6 hours, mm
derivation: rolling sum of rain_mm (6 h)

description: Rain over the last 24 hours, mm
derivation: rolling sum of rain_mm (24 h)

description: none / light / moderate / heavy
derivation: cut of rain_mm at [0.1, 2.5, 7.6] mm

description: Rain reading was missing and filled with 0
derivation: sentinel / gap flag

description: Number of event windows active in the zone-hour
derivation: count of distinct events

description: Log of summed expected attendance of active windows
derivation: log1p(sum attendance); blanks = median of type (0 for types that never state attendance)

description: Hours until next event starts in the zone (cap 48)
derivation: searchsorted on sorted starts

description: Hours since last event ended in the zone (cap 48)
derivation: searchsorted on sorted ends

description: How many of the three lags were missing and had to be filled
derivation: count of NaN in lag_336h / lag_504h / lag_672h before filling

description: Trips in the same zone 14 days earlier (spikes capped; holes filled)
derivation: shift(336 h); if missing: mean of the other lags, else train zone x hour-of-week mean

description: Trips in the same zone 21 days earlier (holes filled)
derivation: shift(504 h); if missing: mean of the other lags, else train zone x hour-of-week mean

description: Trips in the same zone 28 days earlier (holes filled)
derivation: shift(672 h); if missing: mean of the other lags, else train zone x hour-of-week mean

description: Mean of the three same-hour-of-week lags
derivation: nanmean(lag_336h, lag_504h, lag_672h); if all missing: train zone x hour-of-week mean

description: Zone's mean trips over the 28 days ending 14 days earlier (trend level)
derivation: shift(336).rolling(672); if missing (start of year / new zone): train zone mean

description: Zone's mean trips over the 7 days ending 14 days earlier
derivation: shift(336).rolling(168); if missing: train zone mean

description: Short vs long level (momentum)
derivation: level_7d / level_28d; 1.0 when either level was missing
